caption: The drawing depicts a stylized object resembling the head of a ram with large, outwardly curled horns, rendered in brown tones that suggest a metallic or rusted iron texture. The object features a central, somewhat triangular head section that tapers downwards, with three rectangular shapes at the bottom, possibly representing teeth or a jaw. The horns, emanating from either side of the head, are symmetrically curved and spiral outward with multiple circular holes visible along their length and the head. The background is a light cream or off-white color, and there are no additional figures or scenery. Near the bottom right of the object, the name "FRANKLIN SYRES" is printed in small, uppercase letters.
title: Moravian Hinge
